ambiguities: The princesse de Parme's own reaction to the duchess's paradoxes (breathless, jolted, 'sauta par peur d'être renversée', exclaiming 'Zola un poète !') is the direct counterpart of the duchess's already-captured rhetorical dominance (accepted event E1) rather than a distinct local outcome for her, so it was left unscored to avoid duplicating/reversing that movement; a reading of mild narrated discomposure for her is nonetheless plausible.

The extended aside about Mme de Varambon mistaking le narrateur for a relative of admiral Jurien de la Gravière, and the parallel anecdote about Mme de Chaussegros, are framed by the narrator himself as essayistic reflection on social misrecognition in general ('il ne me rabaissa ni ne me suréleva au point de vue mondain'), explicitly disclaiming any status change, so le narrateur was not scored as a staged social participant here.
